1.2 km of autumn moor

Shuttlemon

A bright autumn day on the heath. Six towns and a campsite sit across five biomes, linked by dirt trails that are quicker underfoot. Side paths climb to optional lookouts, and you can step inside the houses. Other walkers in your room appear as coloured figures. Wild creatures roam the moor: press F next to one to battle it for wins. To catch one, forage ingredients in the woods around Ember Camp, cook a stew at the camp fire (F; time your knife cuts well for a stronger stew), and beat the creatures it draws in. Each catch uses a Shuttleball, found inside the houses or bought at a village shop (gold sign) where you can also sell ingredients and creatures, buy rice, and buy the camp upgrade kit that lets the stew use rice. Open the map to find your way. Win 25 battles to earn a Mega Stone: then a partner of Lv 5 or higher can Mega Evolve once per battle.
